   b) **Gradient tilting:** During optimization, we artificially shift the gradient toward regions where the overlap is increasing at high-frequency lags.  
   This differs from previous strategies by explicitly targeting the spectral characteristics of the overlap instead of relying solely on gradient descent. We expect this to find solutions with cleaner boundaries between active and inactive regions, which inherently reduces overlap.
